Hannah_CS: Quick flag — SparrowPay (Enterprise) embed usage down ~58% past 9 days, gen down ~12%. Renewal in 5w. Procurement asked for a competitive bench vs AltModel. Champion left last month. Need triage + retention plan. @Owen_CSM @Devon_SE can we sync?

Owen_CSM: Ack. Paste top metrics and dashboard link pls. Any billing churn signals?

Hannah_CS: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/sparrowpay/usage — embeddings -58% WoW, active tokens -33%, 429 spikes intermittently. No increase in 5xx.

Devon_SE: Any model or SDK changes? Embeds often drop when prefix caching breaks or a quantized variant is rolled.

Hannah_CS: Timeline: client SDK bumped 2026-05-02; model routing nudged to `sparrow-embed-q` at 40% on 2026-05-03 then 80% two days later.

Priya_Analytics: I'll run KV hit rate, token-length histogram, and route-level cohorts. Expect a 1-slide summary in <4h.

Lena_RevOps: We can offer a 14-day targeted reserved pool up to $7k or a one-time invoice credit. Need acct id + last invoice to approve.

Owen_CSM: Outreach: 20-min readout with procurement + eng + new PM. Offer trial/credit, tailored perf/cost comparison, and a short re-onboarding for the new PM.

Devon_SE: I'll prepare rollback steps to previous embed variant and a live KV hit demo. Quick self-check they can run: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/SPARROW/kv_hits`

Hannah_CS: Draft outreach: "Hi team — noticed embed volume dropped. Can we schedule 20 min to share a tailored perf readout, a proposed mitigation (trial credit + reserved pool), and next steps? Tue/Wed next week? — Hannah"

Owen_CSM: Add: "we'll use your traffic to simulate expected latency/cost changes if we rollback or tune" to avoid price-only conversations.

Priya_Analytics: Posting slide in 2h.

Lena_RevOps: Sent invoice INV-9912 to Hannah. Legal notified for promo T&Cs. Marking renewal-risk and high priority.

Hannah_CS: Scheduling Tue 10am PT readout. Devon/Priya/Lena please join. Will update after call with actions.
